stem: A genetically female population shows isolated atypical reproductive structures after a period of environmental stress. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: Sex expression should be documented with genotype, developmental and environmental context before making stability claims
The observation can be ignored because the seed source was feminized
One structure proves every descendant will show the same expression
rationale: Observed reproductive expression can be influenced by biological and environmental context. Stability conclusions require documented repeated evidence rather than a single observation.
